_comment: Nature's Blooms retainer roster. SOURCE OF TRUTH is '~/Desktop/NaturesBlooms - November Retainer Tracker.xlsx' (23 creators). Rebuilt 10 Nov 2026 directly from that sheet, column for column. Rates and commitments must match the sheet exactly — do not 'normalise' them. Three handles are deliberate, verified overrides of the sheet (see handle_note on each). One creator (Ash) is unresolved and one (Daisy) has no handle: both carry resolved=false and are reported but never matched to API data.
